findings.finding: For FAV-effective paths (FAV_TAKER and low-RV V1), F is set only on a valid book at age exactly 12,000 ms. The first later valid call with no F marks initial_context_invalid and the FAV branch emits no intent. It never substitutes a later side for F. UNDER-effective branches do not depend on fixed F; V2 low-RV is no-trade.

findings.finding: The invalid-book guard returns before age/F validity logic, and the runner skips policy.intent when q is None. If a FAV-effective market lacks a valid 12-second book and has no later valid book before EOF, it generates no intents but initial_context_invalid may remain false; result policy_validity can then say VALID_OBSERVED_CONTEXT. The no-trade outcome holds, but invalid marker coverage is not total for this edge case.

evidence.supports: Book-invalid return precedes the missing-12s invalid flag
No policy call when quotes are None
Result validity label depends only on initial_context_invalid

findings.finding: The 300-share predicate uses confirmed inventory only. The producer still derives pending quantity from nonterminal ledger carriers and supplies it to the policy; excluding pending from the holdings predicate does not mutate that ledger. The adapter validates that every prior nonterminal owner remains explicit as KEEP or CANCEL, commits the plan against the existing gateway ledger, and the comparison producer emits no CANCEL. The pre-order predicate is not a hard post-fill ceiling because an allowed 15-share intent is not clipped.

This supports source-level strict IOC/no-resting semantics.
